instruction.text: Find all the informal language in the email.

atoms.sound: To whom it may concern. Hope you’re doing alright! I am writing to let you know why I would like to work for your company. I am a super hard worker, and the job seems sick. In addition, I have all the qualifications required for this position. I’m not too bad at accounting and have previous experience in a similar role. Let me know what you think! See you soon! Martyn.
